Which dental tissue has the HIGHEST toughness (total area under the stress-strain curve before fracture)?
A) Enamel
B) Dentin
C) Ceramic crown
D) Glass ionomer

Statement: 'Enamel is tough compared to dentin.' Is this statement scientifically True or False?
A) False — Enamel is the hardest tissue, but it is brittle with low toughness compared to dentin
B) True — Enamel is both tougher and harder than dentin
C) True — Because enamel has a higher Young's modulus
D) False — Dentin has higher hardness than enamel
